scope: mcp-bpmn-lz7 filename metadata and focused tests only
intent: Preserve exact process IDs and names in listDiagrams while retaining legacy filename compatibility.
applied_fixes: Use versioned filename metadata so new listings do not parse every BPMN file.
Fall back to bounded historical filenames when encoded metadata would exceed 255 bytes.
Cover versioned, legacy, unreadable, and long-name listing paths.
residual_risks: Legacy and custom filenames require bounded BPMN parsing until they are resaved in the versioned format.
